info.title: OPS API
info.description:
Multi-tenant operations API: authentication, subscription plans,
organizations with role-based permissions, teams, clients, projects, tasks,
subtasks, time tracking and time-complexity estimation.

Authentication is a stateless bearer JWT sent in the `Authorization` header.
Organization-scoped routes additionally require the active organization in the
`x-organization-id` header, or in an `:organizationId` path segment, which
takes precedence when both are sent; your membership in that organization is
verified on every call and the permissions of your role decide what is allowed.

Record collections are paginated with the `page` and `limit` query parameters
and wrapped as `{ items, total, page, limit }`. A few catalogue endpoints
(`/plans`, `/subscription/usage`, roles, role templates, members, team members
and time-complexity variance) answer with a plain JSON array instead.

Every response body is JSON, errors included: errors carry a `statusCode`, a
`message` and a `path`, and list `error` when several fields are invalid.

roleId.description: Role the member keeps access through

permissions.description: Complete permission set the role grants after this call

role.description: Team-scoped role (never an organization-level access source)

clientId.description: Client of the same organization the project is delivered for

budget.description: DECIMAL(10,2) returned as a string to preserve precision

clientId.description: Client of the same organization (null detaches the client)

color.description: Display color as a hex value

teamId.description: Team of the same organization the task is assigned to

badgeId.description: Optional badge of the same organization (classification, spec §10)

teamId.description: Team of the same organization (null detaches the team)

badgeId.description: Badge of the same organization (null clears the classification)

assignedTo.description: Assignee; must be an active member of the team assigned to the task (spec §11)
New assignee; must be an active member of the task team

subtaskId.description: Subtask the time is logged against

exitTime.description: Leave empty for a running timer

durationSeconds.description: Duration in seconds; live while the timer runs

isRunning.description: True while the timer is running

entry.description: The running timer of the caller, or null when nothing runs

entryTime.description: Defaults to now; must not be in the future

timeEntryId.description: Timer to stop; defaults to the active timer of the caller

exitTime.description: Defaults to now; must be after entry_time

subtaskId.description: When set, must belong to the referenced task

minDuration.description: Minimum expected duration: seconds or ISO-8601 duration (PT2H)

maxDuration.description: Maximum expected duration, greater than or equal to minDuration

minDuration.description: Minimum duration as a PostgreSQL interval literal, rendered from the stored value

maxDuration.description: Maximum duration as a PostgreSQL interval literal, rendered from the stored value

actualSeconds.description: Actual logged seconds (sum of time entries)

variance.description: Actual duration relative to the envelope

key.description: Grouping key: id, or an ISO date when groupBy=day

label.description: Resolved label when the group is a user, project, client, task or subtask

overSeconds.description: Sum of the overflow beyond max_seconds across subtasks

timeByGroup.description: Time aggregated by the requested grouping

completionRate.description: Share of tasks in done status
